name: Hoshine Silicon Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Hoshine Silicon Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of silicon-based materials in China and internationally. It offers solar panels, including N-type monocrystalline high-efficiency bifacial modules; silicon metals, silicon metal powders, and fine silicon metal powders; and graphitized carbon electrodes.
